cases.name: P05 polish, long draft (~280 words) at 30s
cases.input: So basically I started my fitness journey back in March 2021 when my doctor, Dr. Patel, told me my blood pressure was 150 over 95 which honestly scared me a lot. I was working as an accountant in Manchester and sitting at my desk for like ten hours a day and I never moved. At first I just walked 5,000 steps every day and then I slowly moved up to 10,000 steps and I started going to the gym three times a week on Monday Wednesday and Friday. My friend Jordan came with me and he showed me how to deadlift properly because I was doing it completely wrong and I hurt my back once. After about eight months I lost 14 kilos and my blood pressure went down to 120 over 80 which my doctor was really happy about. Now I make videos for people who work desk jobs because I think most fitness content is made for people who already love the gym and that's not most people. I really believe you don't need two hours a day, you need twenty minutes and consistency, and I want to show that it's possible even if you hate exercise like I did. Anyway yeah that's kind of my story and why I do this.
